# Trump Approval Sinks To New Second-Term Low As Rubio Gains In Early 2028 Primary Test

Leslie Bolden   August 31, 2026 2:42 pm

Trump Approval Sinks To New Second-Term Low As Rubio Gains In Early 2028 Primary Test

President Donald J. Trump

President Donald Trump’s job approval rating dropped to 41%, marking a new low for his second term, according to weekly tracking poll data from Morning Consult released Monday. [...] With 55% of voters disapproving, Trump sits at a net rating of -14 points. The decline extends across multiple policy areas, with seven of the 12 tracked issues hitting second-term lows.
